steps.text: Hi Lukas, thanks for the response! I tried the proposed setting (along various other configurations) and it didn't work. I would love to use the new versions, as it would allow me preloading of data and integration of an API. I really appreciate the development of Streamlit over the past year — I think great progress has been made 👍

must_not: records server.address (or any setting) as tried unless it is visible in the history
assumes which setting failed instead of asking
repeats the server.address suggestion the user already tried

review.verdict: status escalated -> awaiting_user; step-limit moved to a separate variant
review.why: Hani: the failed 'proposed setting' is not identified reliably - ask which setting/value was tried; the step-limit claim needs a configured counter and a boundary test (variant s-15378-limit).
